}

// @public
export interface Wrapper<P = Row[]> {
    (params: WrapperParams & {
        parsed: true;
    }): Promise<P>;
    (params?: WrapperParams): Promise<unknown>;
}

// @public
export interface WrapperDef {
    api?: string;
    auth?: boolean;
    deprecated?: string;
    family?: EspnFamily;
    fixedParams?: Record<string, string | number | boolean>;
    flat?: boolean;
    host?: string;
    includePrefixes?: string[];
    legacyShort?: string;
    nowToggle?: string;
    nowVariant?: string;
    parser?: string;
    // (undocumented)
    path: string;
    // (undocumented)
    pathParams: PathParam[];
    publicName?: string;
    publicShort?: string;
    // (undocumented)
    queryParams: QueryParam[];
    returnsSchema?: string;
    // (undocumented)
    scope: Scope;
    short: string;
}

// @public
export type WrapperFn = (params?: Record<string, any>) => Promise<any>;

// @public
export type WrapperParams = {
    [param: string]: unknown;
};
